chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: Closing reflections: fifty years in Chicago as a love story
summary: Saunders says Chicago and its people have been good to him and ends the interview with thanks to DeMichael.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Yeah. All I can say is, and all of these stories and all of this reminiscing and all this talking and everything, only fortifies what I said before. I wouldn't give you anything for the 50 years that I've had in the business here in Chicago. Chicago has been good to me and the people here have been good to me. So, I mean, you can't ask for anything more than that, because so many guys have been out on the road and in tragic endings and whatnot. But, me, it's just been a beautiful story all the way through. I mean, it's a love story. Love with the city and the people, you know?
Well, you've done a lot for Chicago, too.

Well, I mean, whatever I did, it wasn't intentional -- I mean, intentionally for the purpose of doing it. I just wanted to do something for the people, because I run into so many beautiful people. Well, like you, Don, I've known you all through the DownBeat years and all of that, and you've always been great.
Right, right, see, so -- and when you get friendships that last that long, you're saying something, you know?
Well, that's a good note to end on.
